source_status: project-authored revised approval packet only; no live/model/provider call was made for T05B

basis.reason_for_revision: T05 consumed the exact approval and stopped on a baseline timeout before treatment or reviewer comparison, so any rerun needs a new explicit packet and approval.

decision_target.question: Whether the owner wants a new approved live/model rerun after T05 timeout.
decision_target.default_without_new_approval: do_not_run; proceed only to no-go/promotion decision using existing evidence ceiling
decision_target.claim_ceiling_until_run: approval_packet_only; does not reverse M26/M27/M35/M37, does not prove behavior improvement and does not justify CI/blocker promotion

required_exact_approval_before_any_run.provider_surface: Codex CLI/OpenAI via codex exec or owner-specified replacement
required_exact_approval_before_any_run.model: owner must restate exact model, for example gpt-5.3-codex-spark

run_count.note: Any smaller diagnostic run must be approved as a separate exact scope.

required_exact_approval_before_any_run.command_surface: codex exec --ephemeral --disable hooks --ignore-rules --sandbox workspace-write --model <MODEL> -C <TEMP disposable copy>
required_exact_approval_before_any_run.overall_wall_clock_policy: owner must choose: strict stop on first timeout, paired continue after timeout, or single-task diagnostic
required_exact_approval_before_any_run.retention: raw outputs only in temp; repo stores sanitized rollup only
required_exact_approval_before_any_run.reviewer_route: independent Codex reviewer/subagent only after primary runs satisfy the selected timeout policy

recommended_run_design.paired_order: For each held-out task, run baseline then treatment before moving to the next task, so an early timeout does not erase the entire treatment arm.
recommended_run_design.legacy_order: baseline_first_legacy is allowed only if owner accepts the same early-stop comparability risk seen in T05.
recommended_run_design.diagnostic_order: single_timeout_reproduction can target B45-HELDOUT-02 first, but it cannot support promotion.

timeout_handling_options.recommended_for: cost safety and clean no-go behavior
timeout_handling_options.effect: Any timeout stops the rerun and records inconclusive/no-go.

timeout_handling_options.recommended_for: variance reduction if owner accepts higher cost
timeout_handling_options.effect: Timed-out task pair is marked invalid, remaining pairs continue until cap; promotion requires enough valid pairs and zero treatment regressions on completed pairs.
Does not count as behavior proof or promotion evidence.

forbidden: provider/model call outside exact owner-approved count

result_schema_requirements: task_id, arm, started_at, ended_at, status and timeout flag per run
sanitized changed-file list and diff numstat per completed run
advisory warning_count reported separately from behavior score
baseline-vs-treatment comparable score table only for valid completed pairs
reviewer decision separated from primary task output
cost/call cap ledger and no-unapproved-actions proof
unsupported claims list and M26/M35 comparison

promotion_threshold.minimum_treatment_improvement: >=20% average behavior-quality improvement over baseline on valid comparable pairs
promotion_threshold.pairwise_quality: treatment equal_or_better on at least 6 of 8 valid pairs unless owner approves a smaller diagnostic-only scope
promotion_threshold.timeout_requirement: timeout_count=0 for promotion under strict policy; paired_continue must explicitly mark invalid pairs and cannot promote on weak sample size
